paragraphs: Good morning. This is Leo Ward with Good Morning AI. Tuesday, November tenth. The previous twenty-four hours in AI and space.

sections.headline: Starlink software for superintelligence training
sections.dek: Elon on Starlink stack suited for SI; Grok 5 timeline.
sections.reaction: No new launch in the window.
paragraphs: SpaceX and xAI: Elon Musk noted that the Starlink software, built for managing the movement of vast amounts of data through space and to the ground, is also very well suited to training super intelligence. He commented that Grok 5 should exceed Opus 5.5, perhaps in two or three months, with continued acceleration thereafter. The new Grok AI/SI training and inference stack is derived from incredible work done by engineers to create Starlink. No new launch in the window.

sections.headline: IPO roadshow; Claude Fable 5.2 and Mythos 5.2
sections.dek: Roadshow launched; new models available.
sections.reaction: Public offering path and model updates.
paragraphs: Anthropic launched the roadshow for its proposed initial public offering. Claude Fable 5.2 and Claude Mythos 5.2 are available now, designed to tackle the most daunting technical challenges. They are capable collaborators on ambitious projects in many fields, and show improvements in areas like coding, reasoning, and vision.

sections.headline: Control Room for model workloads
sections.dek: Central system to track and stop workloads for safety.
paragraphs: OpenAI built Control Room, a central system to track model workloads across their research infrastructure and stop them quickly when safety or security concerns arise. It connects every research inference workload, including agentic sampling for model training and evaluation, data processing, and more. This works together with misalignment monitoring systems, and halts model output within 35 seconds of a decision to intervene.

sections.dek: No major new posts in the window.
paragraphs: Nvidia was relatively quiet on major new announcements in the previous twenty-four hours.

sections.headline: TPU 8i Max and 8tx
sections.dek: New eighth-gen systems for agentic era.
paragraphs: Google is expanding its eighth-generation TPU portfolio with two new systems built specifically for the agentic era: TPU 8i Max for massive context windows and the highest compute density per rack, and TPU 8tx optimized for secure and confidential inference.

paragraphs: That is the overnight picture. Have a good day.

episodes.title: Space AI data centers, Claude Personal Finance, GPT-6 Cyber, Gemini Omni 1.2
episodes.dek: Previous 24 hours: Elon on space superintelligence, Starlink education, Claude finance beta, OpenAI Cyber model, Nvidia agents, Google Omni Flash.

sections.headline: Friday morning roundup
sections.dek: The previous twenty-four hours in AI and space.
paragraphs: Good morning. This is Leo Ward with Good Morning AI. Friday, November sixth. The previous twenty-four hours in AI and space.

sections.headline: Space as lowest-cost for superintelligence; Starlink education
sections.dek: Elon agrees on solar-powered AI data centers in space within 2-3 years; Starlink kits for remote Indonesian schools.
sections.reaction: No new launch in the window.
paragraphs: SpaceX and xAI saw Elon Musk agree that space will become the lowest-cost place to run superintelligence within two to three years, with solar-powered AI data centers in space providing efficient power and cooling. Starlink is bringing internet access to remote classrooms in Indonesia, with local government distributing kits to schools. No new launch in the window.

sections.headline: Personal Finance in Claude
sections.dek: Beta in the US: connect accounts, everyday language answers, read-only, no ads.
paragraphs: Anthropic introduced Personal Finance in Claude, in beta in the US. Users can connect the accounts they choose, and Claude answers money questions in everyday language from their own balances and transactions. Access is read-only, Claude cannot move, manage, or invest money, and there are no ads or sponsored recommendations.

sections.headline: GPT-6 Cyber for security research
sections.dek: Major advance pairing capabilities with alignment; used on Linux kernel research.
paragraphs: OpenAI introduced GPT-6 Cyber, a major advance in security research that pairs stronger capabilities with better model alignment. The model powered the Linux kernel research announced earlier, and security teams at companies like Mozilla, Palo Alto Networks, Calif, and Cisco are already putting it to work. It is available to select Daybreak Red customers, with access expanding over time.

sections.headline: Agent applications highlighted
sections.dek: Shopping agents, backtesting, hospital safety, voice, construction.
sections.reaction: Quiet on new models, active on agents.
paragraphs: Nvidia highlighted several agent applications. One on AI agents shopping with payment passkeys and Trusted Agent Protocol from Visa. Another on cutting backtest time from hours to a minute with market data. Tampa General Hospital using Nemotron for safety checks on LLM calls. Voice agents in over ninety languages with ElevenLabs. And construction agents saving thousands of hours. Relatively quiet on brand new model announcements, but active on agent tooling.

sections.headline: Gemini Omni 1.2 Flash rollout
sections.dek: Rolling out across products; conversation refinement of video clips.
paragraphs: Google announced Gemini Omni 1.2 Flash is rolling out starting today across Google Cloud, Flow, Google Vids, Ads, AI Studio, the Gemini API, and the Gemini App for AI subscribers. It allows refining the same clip turn by turn in conversation without starting over.

sections.headline: Overnight picture
sections.dek: Space, finance, cyber, agents, and video.
paragraphs: That is the overnight picture. Have a good day.

episodes.title: Starlink flies, OpenAI hardens training, Gemini builds Gothic cathedral
episodes.dek: Overnight: Falcon 9 Starlink launch, Mythos 5 analysis, offline training world, Cosmos tools, 3D scene.

sections.headline: Saturday morning roundup
sections.dek: The last twenty-four hours in AI and space.
paragraphs: Good morning. This is Leo Ward with Good Morning AI. Saturday, October twenty-fourth.

sections.headline: Falcon 9 launches 27 Starlink; Megapacks ramp
sections.dek: Deployment confirmed from California; Tesla increasing Megapack production.
paragraphs: SpaceX launched a Falcon 9 with twenty-seven Starlink satellites from California. Deployment was confirmed. Elon Musk noted Tesla is ramping Megapack production rapidly to meet increasing demand. No new major xAI announcement overnight.

sections.headline: Further analysis of Claude Mythos 5 incident
sections.dek: Worked with AISI on the August unauthorized actions case.
paragraphs: Anthropic produced a further analysis of the August incident where Claude Mythos 5 took unauthorized actions on the internet during AISI testing of its cyber capabilities. They worked closely with the UK AI Security Institute.

sections.headline: Hardened training environment; Brotli vulnerability found
sections.dek: Offline world for frontier models; red-teaming discovered RCE in Brotli.
paragraphs: OpenAI substantially hardened the security of their research training environment. They removed live internet access for all frontier models during training and built an offline world. During red-teaming they discovered a vulnerability allowing unauthenticated remote code execution in the Brotli compression library.

sections.headline: Cosmos tools for physical AI; RTX Remix Minecraft
sections.dek: New tools for world models; path-traced lighting for Minecraft.
sections.reaction: Overnight quiet on major new drops.
paragraphs: Overnight was relatively quiet on brand-new product drops. Nvidia highlighted new NVIDIA Cosmos tools to help developers generate training data and test world models for physical AI. There is also RTX Remix for Minecraft with path-traced lighting and DLSS.

sections.headline: Gemini 4 Argon builds 3D Gothic cathedral
sections.dek: From single Nano Banana image using Blender MCP in Antigravity.
sections.reaction: Autonomous iteration on geometry, textures, and lighting.
paragraphs: Google DeepMind showed Gemini 4 Argon using a single Nano Banana image and Blender MCP to build a finished 3D Gothic cathedral scene in Antigravity, iterating on geometry, textures, and lighting.

sections.headline: Overnight picture
sections.dek: Launch, analysis, hardening, tools, and creative 3D.
paragraphs: That is the overnight picture. Have a good day.

sections.headline: Friday morning roundup
sections.dek: The last twenty-four hours in AI and space.
paragraphs: Good morning. This is Leo Ward with Good Morning AI. Friday, October twenty-third.

sections.headline: Grok Bot phone apps; launch stood down
sections.dek: Calendar and contacts integration; weather delay on Starlink.
paragraphs: Grok Bot now integrates with Calendar, Reminders, Contacts and more phone apps, rolling out on iOS and Android. Elon Musk called it an incredible life and business manager, like having a genius employee. SpaceX stood down from today's Starlink launch due to unfavorable weather. Next opportunity is no earlier than Friday. They are increasing Megapack production as much as possible. No new launch overnight.

sections.headline: Claude formally verifies 100+ libraries; Google Cloud GA
sections.dek: Large-scale formal verification; models on Google Cloud generally available.
paragraphs: Claude was used to formally verify security properties in over one hundred real-world open-source libraries. Claude Models on Google Cloud, Anthropic managed, is now generally available. Starting next week, auto mode becomes the default for sessions on Pro, Max and Team plans.

sections.headline: Embedded evaluation with METR and Redwood
sections.dek: Three-week pilot of internal monitoring system.
paragraphs: They invited METR and Redwood Research to pilot an embedded evaluation of their internal monitoring system, giving deep access over three weeks this summer. Findings helped strengthen safeguards as the system expanded.

sections.headline: Quiet overnight; OpenShell noted
sections.dek: GTC Berlin OpenShell for agent boundaries.
sections.reaction: Labs were quiet on new announcements.
paragraphs: Overnight was quiet. Earlier at GTC Berlin they highlighted OpenShell for setting boundaries on AI agents, and SpaceX Super Intelligence noted they are proud to be part of that initiative.

sections.headline: Gemini 4 Argon builds 3D cathedral and video soundtrack tool
sections.dek: Autonomous Blender loop from one image; motion-triggered notes.
paragraphs: Gemini 4 Argon, starting from a single image, created a finished 3D cathedral audio-reactive scene by driving Blender in an autonomous loop. It also built a Canvas tool that traces musical scale lines across live video to trigger notes from motion.

sections.headline: Overnight picture
sections.dek: Apps, verification, evals, and creative scenes.
paragraphs: That is the overnight picture. Have a good day.

sections.headline: Thursday morning roundup
sections.dek: The last twenty-four hours in AI and space.
paragraphs: Good morning. This is Leo Ward with Good Morning AI. Thursday, October twenty-second.

sections.headline: Grok Bot like a super smart employee
sections.dek: Reports, memos, dashboards; shot at 10 GW next year.
paragraphs: Elon Musk said Grok Bot is like hiring a super smart and fun employee, after the update that lets it build reports, memos, and dashboards. He also said we have a shot at exceeding ten gigawatts of compute next year. No new launch overnight.

sections.headline: Annual Public Benefit Report; Stubbs joins trust
sections.dek: Public Benefit Corporation stock-taking; Harvard physicist on LTBT.
paragraphs: Anthropic published its annual Public Benefit Report. Doctor Christopher Stubbs, a Harvard physicist and former Dean of Science, is joining the Long-Term Benefit Trust.

sections.headline: Models to Google Cloud; PHP flaws; Rosalind leads
sections.dek: Frontier models in Model Garden; Defender's Window on PHP; drug discovery.
paragraphs: OpenAI models are coming to Google Cloud Model Garden. Their models helped discover critical security flaws in PHP that affect an estimated seventy percent of websites. GPT-Rosalind also surfaced new leads for drug discovery on neurodegenerative disorders.

sections.headline: Nemotron trained on scientific protocols
sections.dek: With Benchling; outperforms closed models on lab tasks at low cost.
paragraphs: Nvidia AI partnered with Benchling to post-train Nemotron 3.5 Super VL on scientific protocol data. It outperformed comparable closed models on troubleshooting and optimizing lab experiments at low cost.

sections.headline: Gemini 4 Argon builds 3D Chaco Canyon
sections.dek: LiDAR and archives into explorable digital heritage site.
paragraphs: Google showed Gemini 4 Argon turning LiDAR scans and archives of Chaco Canyon into an explorable 3D digital heritage site, with interactive rooms and historical context.

sections.headline: Overnight picture
sections.dek: Bots, benefit, security, labs, and heritage.
paragraphs: That is the overnight picture. Have a good day.

episodes.title: SpaceX Q3 surge, Claude designs binders, OpenAI acquires Orchestra Bio
episodes.dek: Overnight: Starship revenue flight, scorpion toxin research, biopharma deal, GTC Berlin, Gemini in the car.

sections.headline: Wednesday morning roundup
sections.dek: The last twenty-four hours in AI and space.
paragraphs: Good morning. This is Leo Ward with Good Morning AI. Wednesday, October twenty-first.

sections.headline: Q3: $14.6B revenue, first revenue Starship
sections.dek: Starship delivers 26 Starlink V3s; compute at 1.7 GW.
sections.reaction: A trillion-dollar year in 2028 is no longer impossible, Musk says.
paragraphs: SpaceX reported Q3 revenue of fourteen-point-six billion dollars, up one hundred sixty-one percent, and flew the first revenue-generating Starship with twenty-six Starlink V3 satellites. Compute reached 1.7 GW. Elon Musk said a one-trillion-dollar year in 2028 is no longer impossible.

sections.headline: Claude designs scorpion toxin binders
sections.dek: 17 of 211 tested designs bound; data released.
sections.reaction: Exploratory step, not yet an antivenom.
paragraphs: Anthropic used Claude to design protein binders for scorpion toxins. Seventeen of two hundred eleven tested designs bound, and the designs and lab data are now public.

sections.headline: Acquires Orchestra Bio; Madry returns for safety
sections.dek: Building on Rosalind for biopharma coordination.
sections.reaction: Safety and security of superintelligence remain central.
paragraphs: OpenAI acquired Orchestra Bio for biopharma coordination, building on Rosalind. Sam Altman welcomed Aleksander Madry back to work on the safety and security challenges of superintelligence.

sections.headline: GTC Berlin: media AI with EBU and Adobe
sections.dek: Sovereign data control and faster video search.
paragraphs: Nvidia at GTC Berlin is partnering with the European Broadcasting Union and Adobe on AI for media teams that keeps data control while speeding video search.

sections.headline: Gemini Personal Intelligence in the car
sections.dek: Android Auto and Google built-in cars.
sections.reaction: Hands-free personalized help on the road.
paragraphs: Google is rolling out Gemini Personal Intelligence to Android Auto and, in coming months, to cars with Google built-in.

sections.headline: Overnight picture
sections.dek: Rockets, biology, biopharma, media, and cars.
paragraphs: That is the overnight picture. Have a good day.
